profile.name: Elton Yasini
profile.title: DESIGNER · ANIMATOR · DEVELOPER
profile.intro: I bring ideas to life through design, motion and code — creating identities, stories and digital experiences where every detail has a purpose.
profile.bio:
I'm Elton Yasini, a multidisciplinary designer, animator and developer based in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe. My work sits at the intersection of visual storytelling and technical problem-solving — shaping how things look, how they move and how people experience them.

I'm drawn to the details that make a difference: a stronger composition, a better-timed transition or a digital interaction that feels effortless. Sometimes that means working with pixels. Sometimes it means writing code. Usually, it's a little of both.
experience: Working Mama — magazine and editorial design.
CN to the Rescue — VFX assistant, rotoscoping and green-screen assistance.
